A.name: Eastern Counties Police Alliance (Account A)
A.business: Regional police consortium across 4 forces (Westmere, Metro Central, Tarn Valley, Norwold).
A.sold: 35 FlytBase Autonomous Drone-in-a-Box (DiaB) docks installed across forces.
A.whyItMatters: Flagship public sector account. 35-dock renewal plus massive 300-dock regional framework tender.
A.handoverNote: Handover context: Rhys Calder championed the rollout, but he leaves in January! Only Westmere and Metro Central fly operationally. Watch out for the tender spec-lock deadline.

people.name: Rhys Calder
people.about: Championed the 35-dock deployment. Claims all 4 forces are keen, but he is departing in January with no successor named!
people.keyConcerns: Legacy calls were with him alone. Urgent transition needed before January departure.

people.name: Insp. Karen Mbeki
people.about: Runs live missions daily. Logged 14 of 18 flying docks last month. Raised an urgent ticket for 5 Dec public event that nobody answered!
people.keyConcerns: Urgent written response needed: pilot training dates and on-call escalation for dock failure before 5 Dec.

people.name: Hannah Doyle
people.about: Controls the commercial framework. Manages the 300-dock tender specification.
people.keyConcerns: Tender spec locks soon. Requires costed operating model showing who flies 300 docks.

deals.title: Annual DiaB Platform License & Support (35 Docks)
deals.blockerReason: Insp. Mbeki has unanswered support ticket for upcoming 5 Dec event; Tarn Valley and Norwold inactive.
deals.unlockCondition: Resolve Westmere 5 Dec event support ticket and deliver pilot training plan.

deals.title: 300-Dock Regional Law Enforcement Framework Tender
deals.blockerReason: The tender specification locks soon with no costed operating model and no agreement on who flies 300 docks.
deals.unlockCondition: Deliver costed operating model with pilot staffing ratios before spec locks.

deals.title: Scale Westmere Force Fleet (+12 Docks)
deals.blockerReason: Mbeki needs proof of response time ROI (12 mins vs 40 mins for helicopter).
deals.unlockCondition: Provide cost per flight comparison against police helicopter unit.

deals.title: Tarn Valley and Norwold go live

actions.title: Respond to Insp. Karen Mbeki’s Urgent Event Support Ticket
actions.businessReason: Westmere public event is on 5 Dec. Mbeki requested pilot training dates and dock failure hotline in writing. Silence is burning trust.
actions.expectedOutcome: Mbeki signs off on support protocol and confirms active Westmere renewal sponsorship.

actions.title: Submit Costed Operating Model to Hannah Doyle Before Spec Lock
actions.businessReason: Tender spec locks imminently. Without an operating model and pilot staffing structure, FlytBase will be excluded.
actions.expectedOutcome: FlytBase DiaB operating model incorporated into the formal 300-dock tender documentation.

actions.title: Conduct Succession Transition Meeting with Rhys Calder & Successor
actions.businessReason: Calder departs in January. Need introduction to interim lead before relationship intelligence is lost.
actions.expectedOutcome: Introduction to incoming alliance programme director.

risks.title: Champion Departure Without Succession (Rhys Calder Leaving in Jan)
risks.consequence: Calder holds all historical relationship context; if unhedged, new leadership could halt renewal.
risks.mitigationPlan: Secure immediate multi-stakeholder meeting with Hannah Doyle and Insp. Mbeki to institutionalize contract.

risks.title: Unanswered Ticket Before Westmere 5 Dec Public Event
risks.consequence: Insp. Mbeki escalates failure to Police Commissioner; blocks 35-dock renewal recommendation.
risks.mitigationPlan: Issue formal written confirmation of dedicated standby engineer and training calendar today.

risks.title: Tender Specification Lockout Without Costed Model
risks.consequence: 300-dock framework locked with competitors or disqualified for lack of operational feasibility.
risks.mitigationPlan: Present turnkey DiaB operating model drafted with Neel Sharma.

blindSpots.question: What is the actual cost per flight comparison between FlytBase DiaB and the regional police helicopter?
blindSpots.whyItMatters: Rhys and Mbeki cite missing person finds (12 mins vs 40 mins), but Hannah Doyle requires hard financial cost-per-flight ROI for the tender.
blindSpots.whoCouldAnswer: Hannah Doyle (Procurement) or Insp. Karen Mbeki
blindSpots.suggestedAsk: Request Westmere aviation fuel and air support budget benchmarks from Hannah Doyle.

blindSpots.question: Why has Tarn Valley never flown a live mission, and why does Norwold only train?
blindSpots.whyItMatters: If 2 of 4 forces are non-operational, the 35-dock renewal is at 50% utilization risk.
blindSpots.whoCouldAnswer: Insp. Karen Mbeki or Tarn Valley Force Commander
blindSpots.potentialImpact: Risk of alliance downsizing contract to only Westmere and Metro Central.
blindSpots.suggestedAsk: Inquire with Mbeki during the 5 Dec prep call regarding Tarn Valley pilot certification hurdles.

paperwork.title: Eastern Counties Force Flight Log (Monthly Telemetry)
paperwork.summary: Verified telemetry log confirming 14 of 18 docks active in Westmere/Metro Central. 2 missing person finds in under 12 minutes.

B.name: Aldermoor Industrial Group (Account B)
B.business: Industrial conglomerate operating 15 chemical & manufacturing plants with 14 autonomous drone docks.
B.sold: 14 Heavy-Duty FlytBase DiaB units for perimeter security, flare stack monitoring, and nighttime patrols.
B.whyItMatters: Anchor industrial account: 14-dock contract renewal plus prospective 40-plant expansion with sister entity.
B.handoverNote: Handover context: Stefan Roy claims €1.2M ROI and 13/15 flying. However, plants pay a share of the security budget and several plant managers resent it. Telemetry shows 3 docks mysteriously stopped flying in November!

people.name: Stefan Roy
people.about: Championed the initial 14 docks. Claims €1.2M annual savings, but glosses over operational friction with plant managers.
people.keyConcerns: Needs formal reporting to convince group CFO and plant managers that drone security is cost-effective.

people.name: Beatriz Alonso
people.about: Direct operator. Says docks are useful at night for perimeter intrusion, but questions downtime and maintenance overhead.
people.keyConcerns: Needs night-time priority maintenance SLA and direct control over local dock schedules.

people.name: Nadia Rahman
people.about: Holds purse strings for security budget allocations. Annoyed by lack of itemized flight-log data to justify cross-plant charges.
people.keyConcerns: Demands plant-by-plant flight logs and verified insurer discount auditing before signing renewal.

deals.title: Annual Industrial DiaB Platform License (14 Docks)
deals.blockerReason: Nadia Rahman refuses renewal until FlytBase provides verified plant-level flight log accounting and ROI proof.
deals.unlockCondition: Deliver plant-by-plant flight reporting package and resolve 3 silent idle docks.

deals.title: Re-activate 3 Idle Docks & Standardize Night Patrols
deals.blockerReason: Three docks stayed online but flew zero sorties in past 2 weeks without tickets or alerts.
deals.unlockCondition: Diagnostic review of telemetry port and local plant manager debrief.

actions.title: Investigate 3 Docks with Silent Telemetry Disconnect (2-29 Nov)
actions.businessReason: Signal alert reveals 3 high-frequency night-flying docks abruptly halted all missions for 2 weeks while remaining online. Silent churn risk.
actions.expectedOutcome: Root cause identified (sensor lockout or local operator boycott) and fixed before Nadia Rahman notices.

actions.title: Generate Plant-Level Flight Audit Package for Nadia Rahman
actions.businessReason: Plant managers resent central budget allocation. Nadia needs itemized flight hours per plant to justify renewal.
actions.expectedOutcome: Nadia unfreezes finance hold on annual platform agreement.

actions.title: Present Nighttime Patrol Case Study to Beatriz Alonso
actions.businessReason: Turn Beatriz from guarded plant manager into an internal operational advocate.
actions.expectedOutcome: Beatriz endorses night patrol expansion at plant managers council.

risks.title: Silent Dock Outage: 3 Docks Halted Flights for 2 Weeks
risks.consequence: Undetected operational outage destroys credibility and violates 99% uptime contract commitments.
risks.mitigationPlan: Dispatch telemetry diagnostic probe to docks and hold technical call with plant leads.

risks.title: Plant Manager Budget Revolt Led by Finance Controller
risks.consequence: Nadia Rahman cuts security allocation, forcing Stefan to cancel dock leases at up to 6 plants.
risks.mitigationPlan: Provide defensible per-plant insurance premium savings audit.

blindSpots.question: Why did the 3 docks stop flying in mid-November despite staying online?
blindSpots.whyItMatters: Is this an automated geofence bug, weather sensor failure, or active operator resistance by disgruntled plant staff?
blindSpots.whoCouldAnswer: Stefan Roy (Head of Security) or Plant 7 Ops Lead
blindSpots.potentialImpact: Threatens €245,000 contract renewal if perceived as chronic hardware failure.
blindSpots.suggestedAsk: Contact Stefan Roy and ask for the dispatch logs from the 3 inactive plants.

blindSpots.question: What is the actual audit basis for Stefan Roy’s €1.2M annual ROI claim?
blindSpots.whyItMatters: Stefan claims €1.2M saved, but finance controller Nadia Rahman remains guarded and demands proof.
blindSpots.whoCouldAnswer: Nadia Rahman (Group Finance Controller) or Stefan Roy
blindSpots.potentialImpact: If ROI is debunked, CFO will reject contract renewal.
blindSpots.suggestedAsk: Request Nadia’s template for security capital expense depreciation and guard labor substitution.

paperwork.title: Aldermoor 15-Plant Fleet Telemetry & Usage Summary
paperwork.summary: Overview of 14 DiaB units. Confirms 3 docks ceased operations in weeks 3-4 of November despite active network heartbeat.

signals.title: Eastern Counties: Rhys Calder is moving on
signals.summary: Rhys Calder has emailed to say he leaves the drone programme in January. No successor is named. Every call on file before the handover was with him alone.

records.text:
From: Rhys Calder
To: (the CSM on the account)
Date: 17 November 2026
Subject: A change on my side

A quick note so you hear it from me. I am moving to another role in the new year and will hand over the drone programme in January. My successor has not been named yet.

Anything we have agreed stands. Until January, keep sending things to the programme office and I will make sure they land.

Rhys

signals.title: Eastern Counties: Westmere needs an answer before a public event
signals.summary: Insp. Karen Mbeki has written directly, and logged a ticket, ahead of a large public event on 5 December. She wants two things settled in writing this week: dates for training more operators before the day, and who answers if a dock fails on the day. Nobody has replied.

records.text:
From: Insp. Karen Mbeki
To: (the CSM on the account)
Date: 18 November 2026
Subject: Public event, 5 December

We are policing a large public event on Saturday 5 December and I want the docks to carry more of it than they do now.

Whatever was said last week, I need two things settled in writing this week.
1. Operators. How many more of my officers can be trained before the day, and when.
2. Cover on the day. If a dock fails, who do I call and how fast does anyone answer.

I am logging this as a ticket as well, so it has a number.

Karen Mbeki
Westmere drone unit
